## {{< var planned >}} `check()`

```{mermaid}
%%| label: fig-check-flow
%%| fig-cap: "The flow of input and output through the check function."
%%| fig-alt: >-
%%|   Diagram showing the flow of input and output through the `check` function.
%%|   The user provides the request and source metadata file. The function
%%|   completes a set of checks, before returning a result that's either the
%%|   unit type or a CheckError.
%%|   

flowchart TD
    request["request<br>path to request.yaml"]
    source["source<br>path to datapackage.json"]
    output[/"Output<br>Result&lt;(), CheckError&gt;"/]

    subgraph check ["check()"]
      read_request["read_request()<br>Read and parse request to Request struct"]
      read_source["read_source()<br>Read and parse source metadata file to Package struct"]
      check_request_keys["check_request_keys()<br>Required keys are present"]
      check_source_keys["check_source_keys()<br>Required keys are present"]
      check_package_name["check_package_name()<br>Request package name matches source package name"]
      check_package_version["check_package_version()<br>Request package version matches source package version"]
      check_resource_names["check_resource_names()<br>Request resource names matches source resource names"]
      check_column_names["check_column_names()<br>Request column names matches source column names"]
      check_row_filters["check_row_filters()<br>Row filters reference existing columns"]
      check_sql_operators["check_sql_operators()<br>Row filters use only allowed operators"]
    end

    request --> read_request --> check_request_keys --> check_package_name --> check_package_version --> check_resource_names --> check_column_names --> check_row_filters --> check_sql_operators --> output
    source --> read_source --> check_source_keys --> check_package_name

    check:::outer_function

  classDef outer_function fill:none
```
